name: Demetrio Madram
source:
Lord of the city of Ishgalia and a member of the ruling council.

[Spoiler] His true identity is that of Duke Bajorla (ﾊﾞｼﾞｵｰﾗ), the ruler of Windal who commissioned the alchemist Magna to complete the blood spring of life. Hundreds of years after Windal fell, he continued the research Magna started to attain eternal youth and immortality with a perfect spring. [/Spoiler]
